title: Result in a window
description: A screen recording or a picture of the result, shown large in a rounded glass window with a thin window bar. The window rises in, the picture grows 2 % very slowly, a caption sits under it. For screens and results, not for portraits.

props.src: required, picture or video (mp4/webm) of a screen or a result
props.caption: one line under the window
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.caption: One story built twice: a deck you present and a page you scroll.
